ABOUT US:
Mizar Partners Pty Ltd is an Australian professional accounting and business advisory firm with offices in Melbourne and Sydney. We provide accounting, taxation, compliance and business advisory services to individuals, sole traders, small and medium-sized businesses, and corporate clients across a wide range of industries.
Our services include bookkeeping, management accounting, taxation, tax planning, business advisory, cash flow management, SMSF support, entity structure advice, financial reporting and compliance support. We focus on providing practical accounting and taxation solutions to help clients maintain accurate financial records, meet their statutory obligations, understand their financial position and make informed business decisions.
Vacant Position: Senior Accountant 
We are seeking an experienced Accountant to join our senior level service team on a full-time basis. The successful applicant will be responsible for preparing, reviewing, analysing financial and taxation information for clients, assisting with statutory compliance, preparing financial statements and tax returns, supporting business advisory work, and providing professional accounting support across a range of client matters.
This role is suited to a professional with strong technical knowledge in accounting, taxation, financial reporting, business compliance, accounting systems, budget analysis, cash flow management and client advisory services.
Hiring Type: Permanent Full-time
Salary Range: Above AUD82,000 + super/ per year 
(The remuneration will depend on the skills, outcomes and experience you can deliver. )
Working Location: Melbourne
Qualification Requirements:
•	Above Master’s degree from Australia or overseas tertiary education provider is a must;
•	Must have a minimum of 3 years’ relevant accounting experience in public practice or business services.
•	Strong communication skills required, including proficiency in English and Mandarin.
•	Hands-on public practice experience delivering end-to-end tax, BAS and financial reporting services for Australian SME.
•	In-depth working knowledge of ATO legislation, payroll compliance, FBT, GST, PAYG and superannuation regulatory rules.
•	Strong proficiency with cloud accounting platforms and advanced Excel for financial modelling and reconciliation.
•	CPA/CA qualified or currently undertaking professional accounting accreditation will highly regarded.
•	Strong knowledge of Australian taxation law and compliance requirements.
•	Clear written and verbal communication skills to deliver straightforward financial advice to non- 
financial business owners.
•	Strong attention to detail and problem-solving ability.

Roles and Responsibility:
This is a senior level accounting service role, with core duties including:
?	Conduct payroll reviews fully compliant with ATO standards, including superannuation contribution calculations and salary packaging deduction audits.
?	Prepare month-end accounting deliverables: cash flow statements, journal entries, ad-hoc performance reports, monthly budgets, balance sheets and formal management reporting packs.
?	Prepare, reconcile and lodge all compliance documentation including Business Activity Statements (BAS), individual, company, partnership and super fund tax returns covering GST, PAYG instalments, PAYG withholding and all statutory tax obligations.
?	Design, update and refine internal financial workflows and general accounting procedures to boost operational efficiency and accuracy.
?	Provide technical guidance and troubleshooting support for cloud-based accounting software systems used by internal teams and SME clients.
?	Compile complete financial statements (balance sheet, profit & loss, cash flow statements), conduct line-by-line account reviews and general ledger reconciliations, and deliver profitability, liquidity and financial health analysis to firm management and directors.
?	Prepare, validate and submit accurate annual Fringe Benefits Tax (FBT) filings for all client entities.
?	Deliver customised professional taxation and structural advice to clients covering business setup,     
growth planning and daily operational financial optimisation.
?	Build robust financial control frameworks to protect client asset integrity, analyse operational expenses and track organisational income and expenditure trends.
?	Serve as the primary liaison for external auditors and support interim and year-end statutory audit procedures for all client portfolios.
?	Correspond and negotiate directly with the Australian Taxation Office (ATO) and other financial regulatory authorities as required for client compliance matters.
?	Identify legitimate tax minimisation opportunities, eligible claim deductions and profit-improvement strategies for individual and business clients.
result.title: Senior Accountant

result.description: ALUMICORP PTY LTD  We are seeking a reliable and technically skilled Mechanical Engineering Draftsperson to support the installation, maintenance, troubleshooting and improvement of mechanical systems and machinery in our aluminium manufacturing facility.   The Mechanical Engineering Draftsperson is responsible for preparing, modifying and maintaining detailed engineering drawings, fabrication documentation and technical specifications for aluminium products, systems and structures. The role supports the design, manufacturing, fabrication and installation functions by converting engineering concepts, project requirements and client specifications into accurate technical drawings and production-ready documentation.  The successful candidate will contribute to efficient and safe plant operations by ensuring the mechanical integrity and optimal performance of production equipment.   Benefits  Salary: $80,000 - $85,000 plus Super depending on experience      Task & responsibilities  Engineering Drafting and Design Documentation  •    Prepare detailed mechanical and fabrication drawings using Computer-Aided Design (CAD) software.  •    Produce shop drawings, workshop drawings and manufacturing drawings for aluminium products and systems.  •    Develop detailed component, assembly and installation drawings.  •    Prepare engineering layouts, sections, elevations and construction details.  •    Create three-dimensional (3D) models where required for project coordination and visualisation.  •    Prepare drawing packages for fabrication, procurement and site installation purposes.  •    Modify and revise drawings in response to engineering reviews, client requests or project changes.  •    Maintain drawing registers and revision control systems.  Aluminium Product and System Design Support  •    Assist in the design development of aluminium windows, doors, curtain walls, balustrades, louvres, façades, screens, canopies and other aluminium structures.  •    Prepare fabrication details for aluminium extrusions, brackets, frames, supports and associated hardware.  •    Interpret architectural, structural and engineering drawings and convert them into fabrication-ready documentation.  •    Assist engineers in preparing technical solutions to meet project specifications.  •    Ensure compatibility between aluminium systems and associated materials and components.  Manufacturing and Fabrication Support  •    Prepare cutting schedules, fabrication schedules and production documentation.  •    Develop material take-offs and bill of materials (BOMs).  •    Generate fabrication details to optimise manufacturing efficiency and minimise material wastage.  •    Coordinate with production teams regarding fabrication methods and assembly requirements.  •    Review manufacturing constraints and recommend practical design improvements.  •    Assist with the preparation of CNC machine data and production files where applicable.  •    Ensure fabrication drawings accurately reflect approved engineering designs.  Site and Installation Support  •    Conduct site measurements and verification where required.  •    Assist in preparing as-built drawings and project close-out documentation.  •    Provide technical support to installation teams.  •    Investigate and resolve design discrepancies arising during construction.  •    Attend project sites to confirm dimensions, installation requirements and compliance matters when necessary.  Continuous Improvement  •    Contribute to improvements in drafting standards, drawing templates and documentation systems.  •    Assist in implementing new CAD technologies and drafting methodologies.  •    Recommend improvements to fabrication processes and product designs.  •    Participate in training and professional development activities.      Qualification & experience      Relevant AQF Associate Degree, Advanced Diploma or Diploma   Minimum of 12 months of relevant industry experience    Work Type:  Full time   Salary:  $80000-85000   Job Publish:  30-06-2026   Job Expire:  30-07-2026   Apply Link:  https://workinitiatives.com.au/job/details?id=5953631   This job is brought to you by workinitiatives.com.au.

The Yarra Hotel is a long-established and much-loved hospitality venue in the heart of Abbotsford, operating since 1855 as a traditional Australian pub, bar, restaurant and live entertainment space. Offering classic and hearty pub-style meals, weekly food specials, a fully licensed bar, large beer garden, function spaces and regular live music, trivia and community events, the hotel serves locals, visitors and groups seeking a relaxed, welcoming atmosphere. With a strong reputation as an Abbotsford institution just a stone’s throw from Victoria Park, the venue values quality food, genuine hospitality, community connection and a positive, team-oriented workplace culture.
About the Position:
The Head Chef role is central to the daily success of The Yarra Hotel’s food offering. You will take ownership of the commercial kitchen, leading menu planning, food quality, cost control and kitchen operations to deliver consistent, high-standard pub meals and specials that meet the expectations of our diverse patrons while supporting the smooth running of the wider venue.
Key Responsibilities:
Planning and designing menus for the hotel
Calculating costs and liaising with suppliers
Directing kitchen operations and managing kitchen staff
Overseeing food preparation, cooking and cleaning processes
Delegating tasks and resolving issues as they arise
Ensuring compliance with hygiene and health and safety regulations
Liaising with the general manager to ensure operations run smoothly
Ensuring all ingredients are fresh and meet quality standards
Requirements:
Australian citizens and permanent residents are encouraged to apply
Certificate III or IV in Commercial Cookery (or equivalent qualification); Food Safety Supervisor Certificate preferred; knowledge of HACCP and food hygiene standards
Minimum 1 year experience working in a commercial kitchen as a chef
Strong technical cooking skills, ability to manage kitchen workflow under pressure, effective leadership and communication skills, attention to quality and cost control, and a collaborative, solutions-focused approach
How to Apply:
To apply, applicants must submit their resume with a valid email address through this online portal.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

result.description:
WELDER (FIRST CLASS) – FULL TIME
Business: DUDIALA ENTERPRISES PTY LTD 
ABN: 67 635 325 192
Trading Name: Universal Metal Fabrication
Location: Unit 2, 42 COLBERT ROAD, CAMPBELLFIELD VIC 3061
Salary: AU$79,500 – AU$85,000 per annum + Superannuation (commensurate with qualifications and experience)
Employment Type: Full-time (minimum 38 hours per week)

Job Published: 18 July 2026 


ABOUT THE BUSINESS
Universal Metal Fabrication is an established Australian metal fabrication business specialising in the design, manufacture, modification, repair, and servicing of custom truck bodies, transport equipment, and fabricated metal components. Operating from Campbellfield, Victoria, the business provides fabrication solutions to commercial transport operators and businesses requiring purpose-built vehicle bodies, structural modifications, repairs, and associated metal fabrication services.
The business undertakes a broad range of fabrication activities including structural steel fabrication, first-class welding, cutting, assembly, fitting, repairs, and the manufacture of custom truck bodies and specialised transport equipment. Operations involve interpreting engineering drawings, fabricating and assembling steel components, performing precision welding, and ensuring completed products meet Australian industry standards, quality requirements, and customer specifications.
Universal Metal Fabrication services clients across the transport, logistics, commercial, and industrial sectors, delivering custom fabrication solutions tailored to individual operational requirements. The business maintains a strong commitment to quality workmanship, workplace safety, operational efficiency, and timely project delivery while continuing to invest in innovation, modern fabrication techniques, and continuous improvement to meet evolving industry requirements.
I would use this version. It reads as a genuine business profile rather than marketing copy, aligns closely with the company's website, and provides a solid factual foundation for a Welder (First Class) (ANZSCO 322313) nomination.

ABOUT THE ROLE
An opportunity exists for an experienced Welder (First Class) (ANZSCO 322313) to join the business on a full-time basis.
This is a hands-on trade position responsible for carrying out a broad range of welding and metal fabrication activities within a workshop and, where required, onsite project environments. The successful candidate will be responsible for interpreting technical drawings, preparing materials, welding fabricated components, inspecting completed work, and supporting the efficient delivery of fabrication projects while maintaining high standards of workmanship and safety.
The position requires the ability to work independently and collaboratively within a fabrication team, maintain production quality, and contribute to the timely completion of engineering and fabrication projects.
This is a permanent full-time position based on a minimum 38-hour working week.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Fabrication Preparation and Material Processing
•	Interpret engineering drawings, blueprints, specifications, and work instructions to determine fabrication and welding requirements.
•	Select, inspect, clean, and prepare metal stock and fabricated components for welding.
•	Measure, mark, and cut steel, aluminium, stainless steel, and other metals using hand tools, flame cutting equipment, power tools, and metal cutting machinery.
•	Shape, bend, and prepare metal sections, pipes, and fabricated components using appropriate manual and mechanical techniques.
•	Prepare workpieces to ensure accurate fit-up prior to welding.

Welding and Fabrication
•	Align, position, and secure fabricated components using measuring equipment, clamps, jigs, and hand tools.
•	Perform welding using appropriate processes including MIG, TIG, Arc (MMAW), and other welding techniques where required.
•	Join metal components through welding, bolting, riveting, and related fabrication methods.
•	Manufacture, assemble, modify, and repair fabricated metal products in accordance with engineering specifications.
•	Complete fabrication work while maintaining dimensional accuracy, structural integrity, and quality standards.

Quality Assurance and Finishing
•	Inspect completed welds for penetration, bead profile, alignment, strength, and finish quality.
•	Identify and rectify welding defects or fabrication inconsistencies where required.
•	Finish fabricated products through grinding, filing, polishing, cleaning, and other finishing techniques.
•	Ensure completed work complies with project specifications, engineering drawings, and quality requirements.
•	Maintain accurate measurements and workmanship throughout all fabrication activities.

Workshop Operations and Equipment
•	Operate welding equipment, grinders, cutting machinery, lifting equipment, and fabrication tools safely and efficiently.
•	Perform routine maintenance and basic servicing of welding equipment and workshop tools.
•	Maintain clean, organised, and safe work areas throughout fabrication activities.
•	Assist with material handling, storage, and workshop housekeeping.
•	Support efficient workflow to meet production schedules and project deadlines.

Workplace Safety and Compliance
•	Comply with Workplace Health and Safety requirements and safe work procedures at all times.
•	Correctly use personal protective equipment (PPE) and welding safety equipment.
•	Maintain awareness of welding hazards, confined spaces, hot works, and safe handling of materials.
•	Report hazards, equipment faults, and safety concerns promptly.
•	Contribute to maintaining a safe, professional, and compliant workshop environment.

MANDATORY REQUIREMENTS
•	Relevant trade qualification in Engineering Fabrication Trade, Fabrication, Welding, Metal Fabrication, or a closely related discipline, together with at least one (1) year of relevant full-time post-qualification experience; or equivalent skills and experience suitable for the position.
•	Demonstrated experience undertaking welding and metal fabrication activities within an engineering, manufacturing, construction, or fabrication environment.
•	Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, blueprints, and fabrication specifications.
•	Demonstrated competency using MIG, TIG, Arc (MMAW), or comparable welding processes.
•	Sound understanding of fabrication techniques, welding quality standards, and workshop safety procedures.
•	Ability to work effectively within production schedules while maintaining quality workmanship and attention to detail.

KEY COMPETENCIES
•	Welding and metal fabrication.
•	Interpretation of engineering drawings and technical specifications.
•	Material preparation and fabrication techniques.
•	MIG, TIG and Arc welding capability.
•	Quality control and weld inspection.
•	Workshop operations and equipment handling.
•	Time management and production workflow.
•	Problem-solving and technical judgement.
•	Workplace Health and Safety compliance.
•	Communication, teamwork, and commitment to continuous improvement.

HOW TO APPLY
Please submit a one-page CV outlining your relevant qualifications, experience, and availability.
Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted.

Employer:	Royal 3PL Pty Ltd t/a Northedge Cabinets and Cladding
Position: 	Office Manager 
Salary: 	       $76,000 – $85,000 Plus Superannuation
Location: 	36 Highlander Dr. Craigieburn VIC 3064
Mode: 		Full-Time
Experience:	1 year experience
Royal 3PL Pty Ltd trading as Northedge Cabinets and Cladding, is an Australian-owned company specialising in the design, manufacture, supply, and installation of premium cabinetry and architectural cladding solutions. The company delivers high-quality products and services to residential, commercial, and multi-unit developments across Australia, working closely with builders, developers, architects, designers, and private clients.
Northedge Cabinets and Cladding provides customised joinery and cabinetry solutions for kitchens, bathrooms, wardrobes, laundries, offices, and other interior spaces, together with innovative cladding systems that enhance the functionality and visual appeal of modern buildings. The company is committed to delivering tailored solutions that meet each client's design requirements while maintaining exceptional standards of workmanship, quality, and customer service.
The business manages projects from initial consultation and design through to manufacturing, project coordination, delivery, and installation. By integrating skilled craftsmanship with efficient project management and modern manufacturing techniques, Northedge Cabinets and Cladding ensures projects are completed on time, within budget, and to the highest industry standards.
As the company continues to expand its operations and undertake an increasing number of residential and commercial projects, it has experienced significant growth in its administrative and operational requirements. This growth has created the need for dedicated management of office operations, customer communications, project administration, supplier coordination, procurement activities, and internal business processes.
To support the continued expansion of the business, Royal 3PL Pty Ltd requires a skilled Office Manager to oversee the company's administrative functions, coordinate office operations, streamline internal processes, and provide essential support to management, production, installation teams, suppliers, and clients. The position plays a critical role in ensuring the efficient day-to-day operation of the business while enabling the company to maintain its high standards of service delivery and support its future growth objectives.
Key Responsibilities:

•	Coordinate the day-to-day administrative operations of the office to ensure efficient workflow and business continuity.
•	Develop, implement and maintain office procedures, administrative systems and record management processes to improve operational efficiency.
•	Coordinate incoming customer enquiries, prepare quotations, maintain job files and ensure project documentation is complete and up to date.
•	Liaise with clients, builders, suppliers and subcontractors regarding project schedules, material deliveries, installation dates and administrative requirements.
•	Prepare and process purchase orders, supplier invoices, customer invoices and related administrative documentation.
•	Monitor office expenditure, maintain financial records and assist management with budget tracking and monthly administrative reports.
•	Coordinate procurement of office supplies and monitor stock of administrative and operational consumables.
•	Maintain accurate records of contracts, supplier agreements, project documentation and company compliance documents.
•	Coordinate staff rosters, leave records, timesheets and other human resources administration activities.
•	Ensure office operations comply with company policies, workplace health and safety procedures and relevant legislative requirements.
•	Prepare regular administrative and operational reports for management to support business planning and decision-making.
•	Identify opportunities to improve office procedures and implement administrative process improvements to enhance productivity and customer service.
•	Provide administrative support to senior management and coordinate communication between office staff, production personnel and installation teams to ensure projects progress efficiently.
	
To be successful in this role, you must have:

•	A relevant qualification in Business Administration, Management, Office Administration, or a related discipline, or equivalent industry experience.
•	At least one year of relevant experience in an office management, administration, or operations coordination role (or as otherwise required under the relevant visa or company policy).
•	Strong knowledge of office administration procedures, document management, and business operations.
•	Excellent organisational and time management skills with the ability to prioritise multiple tasks and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
•	Demonstrated leadership and supervisory skills with the ability to coordinate and support administrative staff.
•	Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to liaise professionally with clients, suppliers, contractors, and internal teams.
